text:
olivia: Customer escalation — mobile dashboard showing legend color mismatches and tooltips pointing to wrong series when tapping. Reported on iOS Safari 16.x and Android WebView. Account acct-9902, ticket SUP-4132. Customer included screenshot + short vid: https://rwd-infer.reports/esc/1865004321/vid

olivia: They also say some datapoints are absent and the "events per minute" line lags by ~3 minutes after live.

samir: Need repro steps, browser versions, HAR, and console. Are they on hosted or private?

maya: Customer repro steps:
1) iPhone 12 Pro, iOS 16.4, Safari
2) Open "inference/throughput" panel
3) Tap the time-range quick switch rapidly (15m -> 1h -> 15m)
4) Observe legend labels shuffle and tooltips show wrong series name

maya: Console snippet they sent:
```
GET /api/metrics/panel?id=thru&range=900 200
GET /api/metrics/panel?id=thru&range=3600 502
Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'label')
```

devon: We rolled compact-legend-mobile flag to 25% yesterday. The new async reorder relies on DOM order which can desync with streaming updates. I can reproduce: trigger websocket point update while quick-switching ranges, legend mapping flips.

devon: Immediate action: roll the mobile flag back to 0% and push a hotfix that binds legend entries to stable data-id attributes instead of DOM index.

ops-bot: deploy bot: rolled compact-legend-mobile to 25% at 2026-03-17T01:05Z (id: clegmob-20260317). Canary error delta +0.7% mobile.

june: Also seeing a billing-rate limiter returning 502s for org=acct-9902 around 00:50-01:10 UTC, which explains missing points. Logs:
2026-03-17T00:58:14Z ingress metrics 502 "billing quota exceeded" org=acct-9902

samir: Two root causes: (1) UI race due to compact legend feature, (2) intermittent 502s from billing throttle causing data gaps. Both together make it look like tooltips point at wrong datapoints.

devon: Rolling back now. Patch PR: https://git.internal/rwd/infer/pull/5022 — fix adds stable mapping + render lock + unit tests.

devon: Hotfix rollout scheduled in patch window tonight. Workaround for customers: Settings -> Display -> uncheck "Compact legend" or use desktop. Also ask them to append ?debug=legendTrace to URL for logs.

june: I'll open billing escalation for acct-9902 and run a one-off backfill for 00:45-01:15 UTC; ETA ~90m.

olivia: I'll update SUP-4132 with rollback confirmation and workaround + credit offer for affected window. Please confirm when rollback completes.

devon: Rollback requested (flag -> 0%). Ops please confirm canary.

june: Canary now showing 0% mobile at 2026-03-17T01:35Z. Billing backfill started.

samir: If customer still sees mismatch after rollback + backfill, ask for HAR and the ?debug=legendTrace output.

olivia: Thanks team — updating the customer now. :thumbsup:
